recommended_action: Protect and grow: VIP tier with early access to new ranges, a named account manager for the top accounts, referral rewards. Avoid blanket discounts - they already buy at full price.
Upgrade to Champions: personalised cross-sell from purchase history, volume-tier pricing and a points scheme that rewards order frequency.
Win the second order: 3-email welcome series with best-sellers and a time-limited incentive on a second purchase within 30-60 days.
Win-back campaign: 'we miss you' email with the new catalogue and one strong one-time offer; short survey on why they stopped; suppress after 2-3 unanswered touches.
Low-cost reactivation only: include in the seasonal (pre-Christmas) newsletter, no paid-media spend; drop from active lists if they stay unengaged.
